description: SSoT MCP security policy (P0-2). Enforced by scripts/security-audit-mcp.ps1 via .githooks/pre-commit-gate.ps1 [9/26]. KB: r2-mcp-security-bestpractices (modelcontextprotocol.io 2026-07-28).

remoteAllowlist.description: Exact-match SSRF allowlist for enabled remote MCP servers. Non-listed remote URL = FAIL.
remoteAllowlist.prefixNote: Trusted prefix but not exact entry = WARN (promote to allowed when legit).

envPolicy.description: Credential-exposure scan over per-server environment blocks. Flagged values must move to vault references.
envPolicy.patternNote: Secret-like values are flagged; placeholder references below are exempt.

pathScoping.rule: Must resolve inside repo scope; filesystem root = FAIL.

versionPin.rule: Any npx command must carry a major.minor pin; unpinned npx = FAIL.

disabledHygiene.description: Known-wide servers that must stay disabled or absent.

confusedDeputy.description: No enabled proxy-like MCP expected; proxy-like env on an enabled server = WARN.
